task.title: Resolve File Conflicts with AI Positron
task.shortdesc: Use AI to analyze a conflicted file, review a proposed resolution, and apply the result to the working copy.

context.p: When a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or stash pop produces a conflict, you can use Resolve with AI to generate a suggested resolution. The AI analyzes the conflicted file and its common ancestor, then opens a review dialog where you can inspect, edit, and apply the proposed result.

step.cmd: On Git Staging > Unstaged files, right-click a conflicted file to open the contextual menu.
On the contextual menu, go to Resolve Conflict > Resolve with AI.
Wait for the AI to generate a resolution, after which the AI Conflict Resolution window opens.
Review the explanation for the resolution on AI Analysis.
On Review proposed changes, compare the proposed resolved file against the working tree, incoming merge, and conflicted versions of the file:

ul.li: Resolved vs Mine: shows the resolved file next to the working tree version.
Resolved vs Theirs: shows the resolved file next to the incoming version.
Resolved vs Conflicted: shows the resolved file next to the conflicted version.
Mine vs Theirs: shows the working copy next to the incoming version.

step.cmd: (Optional) Edit the AI suggestion directly in any Diff File view.
(Optional) Select Restore Original AI Suggestion to discard manual edits to the resolved file.
Select Apply AI Suggestion to accept the resolution.

result.p: The resolved content is written to the working copy and the file is staged automatically.

postreq.p: To customize AI conflict resolution behavior, go to Git Client AI preferences.
